activity_summary: Susanna named the cooper's plot and what was saved, Judith shouted what the street had shouted, and Hamnet had a nail that had bent in the heat. The carpenter said fire makes work. Anne came from the baker's with a new leather bucket and said it makes debt. The twins disputed the handle. When Susanna said you had answered a question nobody asked, you took the bucket yourself. Anne said you would go home by the Guild Chapel.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Dropped the joinery when Susanna stopped him, and took the bucket.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Brought the bucket, answered work with debt, and named the way home.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the cooper's plot, and stopped the unasked answer.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the bent nail, and tried for the bucket.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Did the shout, and split the three things so they would not be traded.

facets.activity: Took the bucket after Susanna stopped the speech

quotes.speaker: susanna_shakespeare
quotes.text: You have answered a question nobody asked.
